title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   D. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   B. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.
   B. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic etiquettes: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dua before and after waking up. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Love; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic etiquettes:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dua before and after waking up.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
